deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 16 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Extended Maximum Capacity\""

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; reads a decoded extended value without proving that the legacy selector activates it.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds SMBIOS version, sentinel, unit and array validation but lowers capability for pending inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify that Extended Maximum Capacity is present, selected and equal to the approved per-array byte capacity when the legacy Maximum Capacity field uses the SMBIOS extended-value sentinel, and remains stable after reboot; otherwise record that the extended field is not authoritative.
original_method: Capture raw Type 16 structures and SMBIOS version, verify structure length includes the extended field, evaluate the legacy Maximum Capacity selector, decode the 64-bit extended byte value only when selected, compare the approved design limit with checked arithmetic, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the per-array capacity and reboot plan. No memory hardware change is intrinsic to the extended-field validation.
required_inputs: Expected maximum capacity in bytes for each array requiring extended representation
Applicable SMBIOS version and minimum Type 16 formatted length
Expected raw legacy Maximum Capacity selector value
Platform architectural memory limit distinct from installed capacity
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS inventory; do not install or remove DIMMs.
Do not read the extended offset unless the raw formatted length includes it.
Treat Extended Maximum Capacity as authoritative only under the defined legacy sentinel rule; preserve both raw values.
Decode the 64-bit byte value with unsigned checked arithmetic and do not substitute installed Type 17 totals.
Stop on absent/truncated selected field, illegal selector relationship or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate structure/version availability, legacy selector, raw 64-bit extended value, byte normalization and approved pre/post reboot comparison.
Do not alter hardware/firmware, infer undocumented capacity or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-array extended capacity, applicable structure/version and architectural-limit basis.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The decoded label is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot prove field presence by length, the legacy selector, raw 64-bit bytes, units or array identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 16 output; report handle, structure length, raw legacy value, selector result, raw extended 64-bit value, normalized bytes and expected architectural limit.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Extended Maximum Capacity scope, Type 16 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and memory modification are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate the extended offset by Type 16 length and SMBIOS support, require the legacy extended-capacity sentinel before treating the 64-bit byte field as authoritative, then compare the approved per-array limit and reboot state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 16 arrays whose maximum capacity requires or exposes the extended representation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC and raw parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 16 Maximum Capacity selector and Extended Maximum Capacity layout/unit definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds structure-length safety, raw selector coupling, exact 64-bit byte decoding and inactive-field treatment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncated offsets, extended values used without their selector, zero/overflow/wrong-endian values and wrong-array associations.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-array capacity and applicable SMBIOS structure/version rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The declared maximum is firmware design metadata and does not prove all supported populations were electrically qualified.

project_override_considerations: A project may target arrays below the legacy threshold where the extended field is inactive; in that case evidence must explicitly show the selector is not set and validate the legacy field instead, not invent an extended expected value.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, per-array byte capacity and SMBIOS selector/length policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16 records and SMBIOS version
Per-array formatted length, legacy raw selector, extended raw bytes, authority decision and normalized value
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw-field comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The extended field is complementary to the legacy Maximum Capacity row and is unambiguous when its selector and structure length are evaluated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Selector-gated raw decoding and capacity comparison are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds field-presence, selector, raw 64-bit, units and active-versus-inactive validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains version/sentinel safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines valid inactive-field handling and separates baseline/verdict ownership.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible decoded extended value from passing when the field is truncated, inactive, wrong-endian or not selected by the legacy field.
independent_technical_reasoning: The extended field has a deterministic length, selector and 64-bit encoding; these conditions and reboot stability are software-checkable once the expected capacity is approved.
